reply.answer_text: That's a personal choice that depends on your circumstances — we can't advise. Both are options: drawdown lets you take flexibly from your invested pot and leave the rest working; an annuity uses your pot to buy a guaranteed income for life. You're entitled to free guidance from Pension Wise (if you're 50+) or MoneyHelper — they'll help you think through what suits you. If you'd like an annuity quote, you can shop around in the open market — you don't have to use us. What we can do is explain how either option works, and what the tax rules are.
